title: Trim Effects Mewo
description: Makes full trims have special effects
body:
This datapack makes it so that having full sets of trimmed armor gives special effects!
The effects are listed here:
        
```
'spire':'health_boost',
		'eye':'regeneration',
		'snout':'fire_resistance',
		'rib':'haste',
		'vex':'invisibility',
		'ward':'absorption',
		'tide':'conduit_power',
		'wild':'hero_of_the_village',
		'coast':'water_breathing',
		'dune':'speed',
		'sentry':'resistance',
		'wayfinder':'slow_falling',
		'shaper':'luck',
		'silence':'strength',
		'raiser':'saturation',
		'host':'glowing',
		'flow':'jump_boost',
		'bolt':'dolphins_grace'
```

Note: Curse of Binding dragon heads also count as a set piece for any set. This is because dragon bros(if you dont know what that is, you should look at Grian's youtube channel)



[Go here for a list of my mods(and mods i reccomend), or just to post your ideas for things for me to make!](https://1101-grills-oren.github.io/mods/)
